name: EmailAsAlternateLoginId
label: Email as an Alternate Login ID
helpText: Explicitly enables or disables signing in with a verified email address as an alternate to the UPN.
executiveText: Controls whether employees can sign in with their email address when it differs from their account name - an explicit setting keeps sign-in behaviour deliberate rather than inheriting Microsoft defaults that can change.
docsDescription: Grades the org-default home realm discovery policy: it must exist, explicitly carry the AlternateIdLogin setting, and match the configured direction. Remediation patches the existing policy or creates the org default.

Enabled.label: Enable Email as Alternate Login ID
